extDescription.message: Attach files without opening the file picker: pick from your clipboard or recent downloads when you click any upload field.

clipboardEmpty.message: No image, file or text in the clipboard.

clipboardNotAccepted.message: The clipboard content isn't accepted by this field ($ACCEPT$).

fileAccessNeeded.message: To attach downloads, turn on "Allow access to file URLs" in the extension details.

fileAccessMaybeOff.message: No download could be read. Check that "Allow access to file URLs" is on.

clickFieldAgain.message: Click the field again to open the system file picker.

errFieldGone.message: The upload field is no longer available.

errFrameNoResponse.message: The upload field's frame didn't respond.

errItemGone.message: This item is no longer available. Reopen the popup.

errTooLarge.message: The file is larger than the configured limit.

errReadFailed.message: Couldn't read the file (it was removed, or "Allow access to file URLs" is off).

optDebugHint.message: (logs to the page console why each click was or wasn't intercepted)

optFileAccessHint.message: Needed to attach downloads. Turn it on in chrome://extensions → Easy Upload → Details → Allow access to file URLs.

optFileAccessOff.message: Off: downloads are listed but can't be attached.
